status: DEFINED - NOT EXECUTED (BLOCKED: CDS credentials unavailable, verified 2026-09-13)
purpose: Minimal, reproducible, auditable ERA5 Primary pilot that validates the v8.7 canonical contract (tempMeanC / tempHighC / tempLowC / precipMm / precipDaysGe1mm-derived-input) for ONE anchor across 1991-2020 before any 145-destination retrieval.

prerequisites.datasetLicenceAcceptance: BLOCKED (must be accepted manually in the CDS user profile per dataset, per current official CDS documentation)
prerequisites.netcdfReader: BLOCKED (netCDF4/xarray absent in system python, verified 2026-09-13)

anchor.name: Narita International Airport
anchor.selectionReason: Tokyo is the instructed preferred pilot anchor; the canonical anchor for destinationId 'tokyo' is NRT/RJAA.

gridSelection.datasetGrid: 0.25 deg regular lat-lon (ERA5 atmosphere reanalysis, per official CDS catalogue description)
gridSelection.requestAreaRule: [lat+0.25, lon-0.25, lat-0.25, lon+0.25] (CDS area order North, West, South, East; official schema default [90,-180,-90,180] confirms N/W/S/E)
gridSelection.pointSelectionRule: From the returned grid points, select the single point minimizing great-circle (haversine) distance to the anchor coordinates; tie-break: higher latitude first, then lower longitude. Fully deterministic.

expectedNearestGridPoint.note: Precomputed from ERA5 0.25 deg lattice; the checks script re-derives it from the returned grid and asserts equality.

timeStandard.officialDefault: utc+00:00 (confirmed in the official CDS retrieve process schema for derived-era5-single-levels-daily-statistics, fetched 2026-09-13)
timeStandard.utripBasis: dailyAggregationBoundary = UTC+00:00 is a UTRIPLA methodology choice; the official default equals it but it is set explicitly in every request anyway.

requestPlan.officialSchemaBasis: data_format IS a defined input for this dataset (enum grib|netcdf); product_type monthly_averaged_reanalysis confirmed; variable enum contains 2m_temperature and total_precipitation (official retrieve process schema, fetched 2026-09-13)

outputUnitExpectations.total_precipitation: m of water equivalent PER DAY (ECMWF conversion table: tp[mm] = tp[m/day] * 1000 * N, N = days in month; NOT a monthly total)

request.year: ONE year per request (official schema: year is a SINGLE string, not an array)

requestPlan.forbiddenKeysReason: FINDING F-1 (2026-09-13): the official CDS retrieve process schema for derived-era5-single-levels-daily-statistics defines inputs [product_type, variable, year, month, day, daily_statistic, time_zone, frequency, area] and contains NO data_format input; output is netCDF-in-zip per the official daily statistics documentation. The previous request template included data_format=netcdf, which is a non-schema input and must be removed.
requestPlan.officialSchemaBasis: daily_statistic enum [daily_sum, daily_mean, daily_maximum, daily_minimum] (single string); time_zone default utc+00:00; year single string enum 1940..2026 (official retrieve process schema, fetched 2026-09-13)

requestPlan.request: identical to R2-daily-maximum except daily_statistic = daily_minimum

validatesCanonicalFields: precipDaysGe1mm (approved derived field, v8.6 Option A: count(daily total precipitation >= 1.0 mm, UTC+00:00 day) -> 1991-2020 mean)
requestPlan.request: product_type=reanalysis, variable=[total_precipitation], daily_statistic=daily_sum, time_zone=utc+00:00, frequency=1_hourly, one year per request, months 01-12, days 01-31, area per rule

outputUnitExpectations.total_precipitation: metres per day of accumulation (daily sum); the >= 1 mm comparison uses 0.001 m threshold

output.isolation: NO file outside pilot/best-time/copernicus/ is written; NASA raw, v8.7 canonical, and all normalized/ artifacts are read-only for this pilot.
output.perRequestSidecar: Each raw response is accompanied by a metadata sidecar: requestId, dataset, full request parameters, retrieval timestamp, byte size, sha256 of the raw file. No credentials, tokens or headers are ever recorded.

semanticProofRequirement.tempHighC: MUST be 'mean over 1991-2020 of (per-calendar-month mean of daily maximum temperature)' where daily maximum comes from hourly data via daily_maximum. It MUST NOT be the ERA5 Monthly Means min/max fields (those are monthly extremes) and MUST NOT be 'monthly average of a monthly extreme statistic'. Official basis: derived daily statistics are computed from hourly data with earthkit-transforms daily_reduce(how='max') (ECMWF daily statistics documentation).
semanticProofRequirement.precipMm: MUST be mean over 1991-2020 of (monthly total) where monthly total = monthly-mean rate [m/day] * 1000 * days_in_month(actual year/month, incl. leap Feb 29). Official basis: ECMWF conversion table for accumulated variables.
